REGENERATED 2026-10-06 by mission lane R (wave 2) for the lead's L219 ruling: "follow the spec (§21.1). 2h domestic -> airport-only." computeWindow's ladder (LayoverSafetyEngine.ts, the tier block) now keeps too_short only for a window with NO certified spare minute (usableMinutes <= 0); every window with spare minutes and no landside answer is airport_only, which is §5's AIRPORT_ONLY state for insufficient time.

WHAT CHANGED, measured by this check before regeneration: 31 compared, 8 changed, 0 added, 0 removed. All 8 changed ONLY result.tier (too_short -> airport_only) and rulesApplied (window.tier.too_short -> window.tier.airport_only): s01-2h-domestic, s02-4h-international-permitted-generic, s07-5h-checked-bags-recheck, s09-arrival-delay, s17-return-soon, s25-unknown-baggage, s28-self-transfer-recheck-declared, s31-checked-through-tickets-unstated. In each the usable window is between 1 and 44 minutes. NO verdict, deadline, usable-minute figure, return state, confidence, reason code or gate rule moved in any scenario: the tier is a label, and nothing in the engine reads it (LayoverEventReplanner reports tierChanged only). s01 is §21.1's own 2h domestic case and now answers its sentence. Every scenario whose window is 0 keeps too_short.
